title: Central entitlement matrix, temporary access, store restore and monetization resilience

requirements.RC-1085: Free and PRO access is centrally resolved by entitlement service
requirements.RC-1086: every governed feature has one canonical Feature ID
requirements.RC-1087: canonical feature IDs represent product capabilities
requirements.RC-1088: UI access uses central Feature ID gate
requirements.RC-1089: service execution uses central Feature ID gate
requirements.RC-1090: menu access uses central Feature ID gate
requirements.RC-1091: UI/menu/route/service cannot diverge through local premium booleans
requirements.RC-1092: PRO snapshot can use every canonical feature
requirements.RC-1093: Free snapshot is restricted by central Free matrix
requirements.RC-1094: rewarded temporary access is a distinct temporary entitlement
requirements.RC-1095: temporary entitlement has explicit UTC validity window
requirements.RC-1096: local rollback-resistant clock raises cost of simple wall-clock rollback
requirements.RC-1097: serverless client protection is not represented as unbreakable DRM
requirements.RC-1098: fail-closed catalog and local verification resist ordinary manipulation
requirements.RC-1099: Google Play ownership uses platform purchase/restore query and verification material
requirements.RC-1100: restore/ownership cache preserves previously confirmed lifetime PRO during store outage
requirements.RC-1101: purchase failure does not mutate user data
requirements.RC-1102: ad unavailable/failure is a non-crashing no-op for core state

promotion_policy: CI may promote NOT_STARTED to IMPLEMENTED only. Real Play purchase/restore device evidence, ad SDK integration, offline device testing and exact-release evidence remain blockers for TESTED/VERIFIED/DONE.
